issues.description: The problem statement asks for the names of all Gemeinden in Oberbayern OR Niederbayern that have a Wanderweg (logical OR). The solution file aufgabe05.sql uses a WHERE clause with (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Oberbayern' AND Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Niederbayern'), which is impossible to satisfy and contradicts the problem requirement. This logical condition mismatch between the problem description and the provided solution will produce an empty or incorrect result and confuse students when they compare their queries to the reference.
issues.suggestedFix: Correct the logical condition in solution/aufgabe05.sql to match the problem statement by using OR instead of AND: change AND (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Oberbayern' AND Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Niederbayern') to AND (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Oberbayern' OR Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Niederbayern'). Ensure the comment or problem text and solution match so students are not misled.
